Habitat V0.3

Changelog

  • Added: NEW TOOL!!! SNAP! Screenshots for windows, areas, screens, scrolling, & Recordings!
  • Added: Squeak Cursor Tools! Now features a quick action dial menu.
  • Added: Spark keep awake settings for Macbook’s, Macs, and connected external displays.
  • Added: New icons! Also changes icon in applications folder now.
  • Improved: Chomp junk cleaner is now redesigned slightly and more thorough at finding unnecessary files.
  • Improved: Grid spacing presets in trackpad gestures.
  • Improved: Background cpu usage increasing over long periods of time.
  • Improved: Leap dock preview works with less stutters and computer resources.
  • Improved: Echo cmd+x cut now makes sound effect outside of finder. Also changed sound effect.
  • Improved: Burrow folder preview pane in finder.
  • Improved: Setup screens permissions transparency. Now includes more permissions at start.
  • Fixed: Squeak input listener not working after immediately opening the tool inside Habitat.
  • Fixed: Leap window preview showing even when doing quick commands.
  • Fixed: Leap dock previews not showing if switching position of the Mac’s dock.
  • Removed: Chomp experimental quitter section under advanced features. No longer needed.


    • More to come.

    — Thank you for all the support & feedback!
